pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit polygonal geometries with irregular, jagged edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck and flank are large and relatively separated, while patches on the posterior flank show reduced surface area and increased spatial density.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space pathways consist of cream-colored linear segments forming a closed-loop topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-point intersections. Path thickness remains stable with minor fluctuations at high-curvature patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, short-pile fringe along the dorsal line of the neck with a consistent low-amplitude serrated contour against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Small, localized, dark raised textural anomalies are visible across the upper flank region.
